notes.title: Relics and bug fixes - 0.5.3
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524432/14631d771fc5bb7ed378c9ecc57b2c8fb7c49f9d.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524432/bd417960cf146736abea30d76795a071a4671057.png[/img]
[h1]Hey![/h1]	

Today we are sending you a small update with a small teaser.. Relics! Along with some much needed bug fixes and tweaks. We hope you enjoy!

[h1]Features:[/h1]
Added 2 relics...
Added falling snow
Added Snow footstep sound
Day sign now animates in and out

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
Farming works again! (kind of..*) 
Dragging vikings is no longer choppy
Trying to select a farm is now much easier
UI should no longer cut outside of the game screen
Camera should no longer focus on the viking from underground
Made fixes to trees so they should no longer fly up in the air or become invulnerable
Day time is now saved
Date is now saved
Fixed false homeless bug
Guards now level up when breaking up fights
Uncommon resources are now saved

* Keep the shapes simple people, we’re still improving it!


[h1]Tweaks:[/h1]
Bush regen rate increased
Increased chance of food poisoning
Increased damage of food poisoning and curses



And if you have ideas for what cool new stuff we should work on, check this out:
https://trello.com/b/qSqAecgZ/mind-the-vikings-ideas

And of course: Talk to us! (we bite gently)
https://discord.gg/q4mPUdP

/Daniel Perlman and Simon Ulander

notes.title: Thought’s n’ Witches - Patch 0.5.1
notes.notes:
Hello my fellow Nords!

Here’s some changes we’ve added to make the game even better, including mind-reading and witchcraft! Some great features are in the works and we are slowly but surely picking up the pace again.

[h1]Features:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Witch Hut is now enabled and fully functional
[*]You can now see what a viking is thinking
[*]“New” notification on vikings disappears after 30 seconds
[*]Trap chance is now displayed for coal and magical plants
[*]Camera position is now saved and loaded
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Farms can now be removed!
[*]Fishing and witch hut profiles now stick on click
[*]Coal and magical plants collected are now saved
[*]Fisherman job is now properly saved
[*]No random smiths showing up
[*]Floating rocks
[*]Mystery curses not showing up anymore
[/list]

[h1]Tweaks[/h1]

[list]
[*]Firewood consumption has been drastically increased
[*]Lowered initial firewood inventory on houses drastically
[*]Food consumption increased as well
[/list]


And if you have ideas for what cool new stuff we should work on, check this out:
https://trello.com/b/qSqAecgZ/mind-the-vikings-ideas

And of course: Talk to us! (we bite gently)
https://discord.gg/q4mPUdP

Also, huge shoutout to Laurie (otherwise known as Berserk-bob), a new developer who has joined the team, and whom is responsible for a lot of the changes in this patch! Thanks for all the patience and feedback, we look forward to bringing you even more awesome content!

/Daniel Perlman and Simon Ulander

notes.title: Hotfix 0.5.0.5
notes.notes:
[h1]Freeze's are only acceptable during Midvinter[/h1]

Here’s a hotfix that should fix the most immediate crashes and freezes you’ve been experiencing. 

Fixed a crash that would happen when you went on an adventure
Fixed a freeze on game load
Fixed a freeze when you throw vikings into water
Fixed a freeze with vikings wandering around

Tweaks: 
Torches and braziers now require a little less coal

Thank you all for being patient and understanding. We pushed ourselves a little too far with the day/night patch, and Danny is currently experiencing some burnout, so we are forced to slow down and lick our wounds for a short while before picking up speed again. 

Thank you for helping us develop this amazing game!

notes.title: Day / Night cycle! - Patch 0.5.0
notes.notes:
[h1]It's time to enter darkness.[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524432/6762e525b0e179f13b58bfeb0cd6f4208bbdb793.png[/img]

[h1]Day & Night cycle[/h1]
Let the darkness surround your island and viking settlement. Set alight all the torches and watch the mist roll in from the ocean. 
The big feature of this patch is Darkness. A much needed change from the monotonous perpetual day we’ve had up until now. 
To adapt the game for this change has been huge, spanning all features of the game, so I hope you can have understanding for how long time it took us to get here! 

[h1]New UI for the buildings to support more types![/h1]
We had to revamp the building UI because the old format just couldnt support this amount of buildings, so this new one should have more space, let us know what you think of it! 

[h1]Torches and Braziers[/h1]
Light up the night with these fancy torches and braziers!

[h1]Adventures & Treasures[/h1]
Send your vikings out on missions to collect valuable treasures!

This feature is the framework that we will try to build raiding around, so please give us feedback on it!

[h1]Log Palisade[/h1]
Ward off evil attackers with this sturdy log wall (evil attackers to-be-added, for now it just looks pretty)

[h1]Coal[/h1]
A “Treasure item” used to build torches and braziers

[h1]Witch’s Hut[/h1]
Recruit a witch to brew concoctions for your vikings, can cure both curses and illnesses.
Currently has no use, but we wanted to show it to you! Functionality will be added in 0.5.1

[h1]Herbs[/h1]
A “Treasure item” used by the witch to concoct potions to cure illnesses etc

[h1]Fishing huts work okay now![/h1]

[h1]The game is now “Very early alpha” instead of “Very very early alpha”[/h1]
We’re getting there!

[h1]Small stuff:[/h1]
Vikings now require more food per day
Days are much longer
Changed horn to a more low-key horn so that your ears will be less likely to explode.
Viking list is now located in bottom right corner
Fishing hut renamed to fishing shack
Road renamed to Wooden Road
Added rarities to the storage inventory
Added a “wake up” button on houses for you to disturb a viking’s beautysleep because why the heck not?

[h1]Bugs:[/h1]
Holy cow we fixed a lot of bugs, but they were produced by the features we just added, so we cannot count them, Doh!
At least we fixed an infinite loop with the farm, so your game should crash less often!

Thank you for having the patience and sticking with us, this patch was a real pain to make, but we sincerely hope you enjoy it!

You can follow our bug-squishing journey here 
https://trello.com/b/jwezI6DE/mind-the-vikings-bugs-issues

And if you have ideas for what cool new stuff we should work on, check this out:
https://trello.com/b/qSqAecgZ/mind-the-vikings-ideas

And of course: Talk to us! (we bite gently)
https://discord.gg/q4mPUdP

Odin’s blessing upon you.
/ Simon Ulander and Daniel Perlman.

notes.title: Quality of Life update - v.0.4.4
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello Viking Overlords![/h1]
We’re adding a few quality of life features before we drop the 0.5.0 patch next week (which we suspect you will like… quite a bit.) 

Here comes a few changes that should make life in vikingville a little easier!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524432/cbf00f6cf0a3aed0dd3461f6c84146e9a0869d22.png[/img]

[h1]Features:[/h1][list]
[*]New UI for vikings, buildings and resources that should hopefully make managing information a little easier
[*]Re-growing forests - saplings now spawn in forest-areas that turn into trees after a while
[*]Launch menu has been totally revamped for simplicity
[*]Range indicator on lumberyard to see it’s area of effect
[*]You can now quickly see how much firewood each house contains by selecting the lumberyard
[*]You can now hold SHIFT to automatically see information on hovered object
[*]Added details to damage, so you can see where damage was taken from
[*]Added confirm quesion on main menu so you don’t accidentally exit game without saving
[*]You can now evict vikings from houses that you think they don’t belong in by draggin another viking onto that house
[/list]
[b]You can now opt-in to the stable version of the game under the beta branch on our game's properties page![/b]

[h1]Bugs:[/h1][list]
[*]Lag when saving the game has been reduced (more fixes are coming)
[*]Fixed gatherers mixing up trees and bushes[/list]

Thank you for reporting issues to us and coming up with awesome ideas! Lets continue this train all the way to valhalla!

You can follow our bug-squishing journey here 
https://trello.com/b/jwezI6DE/mind-the-vikings-bugs-issues

And if you have ideas for what cool new stuff we should work on, check this out:
https://trello.com/b/qSqAecgZ/mind-the-vikings-ideas

And of course: Talk to us! (we bite gently)
https://discord.gg/q4mPUdP

Odin’s blessing upon you.
/ Simon Ulander and Daniel Perlman.

notes.title: Oceans, Fishing and better Terrain - Patch 0.4.2
notes.notes:
[h1]Gott kveld Vikings![/h1]

Today im happy to reveal something we’ve been wanting to do for a long, long time... Water! 
Ocean, lakes and rivers, as well as vastly improved terrain generation

[i]0.4.1 & 0.4.0 saves should be atleast functional in this patch[/i]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524432/cf3c2d53f62e4bf6b0ca4d4d776a3c6282b85ae2.png[/img]

With that said, I would like to announce a competition! Whoever can take the most awesome screenshots of their new and updated maps will get 3 copies of the game to give to their friends! We want to update the pictures on the steam front page, and we thought what better way to do that than with your pictures?

[url=https://discord.gg/q4mPUdP]You can learn more about this competition on discord[/url]

Changing the landscape this much was a huge undertaking for this week, but we couldn’t just add water without fishing right?? That’s why we squeezed in a fishing hut which I hope will give you some options in terms of what kind of village you want to build

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31524432/c3c08d4707c7d95ad2f72e5866cc075d5fd35b74.png[/img]

You can now also share maps with each-other with seeds! I would love to see what kind of wierd landscapes you can find :)

While we were in the process of improving the terrain we also changed these things:
- Map size has been doubled
- Camera speed and pitch is now based on a fixed value, rather than distance-to-ground
- Added wetlands texture near ocean
- Changed rock texture

Thank you for coming with awesome ideas and helping us develop this game, we look forward to delivering even more of your suggestions!

You can follow our bug-squishing journey here 
https://trello.com/b/jwezI6DE/mind-the-vikings-bugs-issues

And if you have ideas for what cool new stuff we should work on, check this out:
https://trello.com/b/qSqAecgZ/mind-the-vikings-ideas

And of course: Talk to us! (we bite gently)
https://discord.gg/q4mPUdP

Don’t forget that vikings are bad at swimming! 
/ Simon Ulander and Daniel Perlman.

notes.title: Clans! Brawling and Death: The Eternal: Patch 0.4.0 is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[H1]Welcome to 0.4.0![/H1]

Let your vikings band together (or brawl together) as clans during your struggles to survive, which has now gotten even harder, with the everlasting presence of Death.

Features:
[list]
[*]Clans
[*]Death - vikings can now die from a plethora of delicious causes. 
[*]Brawls! - Vikings love fighting, so let ‘em!
[*]Guards: If you don’t dare unleash the full potential of the Viking spirit, train [*]some guards to prevent everyone from killing each-other
[*]Guard-post: Used as a vantage-point for your Guards
[*]Difficulty options
[*]Hill & Mountain slider
[*]Health - Vikings now display how much health they have remaining until their inevitable Death
[*]Houses now display what clan the vikings residing within it belong to
[*]Outline now shows what clan the viking belongs to
[*]Increased viking spawn-rate by 100%
[*]Added a notification widget for important messages that will certainly annoy you
[*]Tweaked trait weights to make it more likely to award positive traits
[*]Added help screen to launch widget + some additional tips
[*]Updated credit-list - Shoutout to Brandon Alexander for his awesome music!
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Reduced time for crops to grow by 20%
[*]Fixed Switching job for a viking in the middle of a job caused confusion 
[*]Made focusing in on vikings less unbearable
[*]By changing a viking’s profession it was possible to re-lock certain buildings, fixed.
[/list]
Not a lot of bug-fixes this patch, but we hope you can appreciate the amount of content we managed to cram into this patch, now, we’re off to bed to sleep for a good long while.. We hope you will enjoy!

Warm greetings from Sweden,
Simon Ulander and Daniel Perlman.

notes.title: Here's a quick hotfix comin' up!
notes.notes:
Here comes a couple fixes if you were experiencing any bugs as a result of yesterday’s content patch :)

Bug fixes:
Resources should no longer go into the negative when vikings are fighting for the last scraps
When you get a proposed viking it no longer displays that it carries a broken tool, but now correctly shows it has a sturdy tool
Vikings no longer interrupt their life to build fences that have not even been placed yet
Road endpoint getting awkwardly rotated has been fixed
Farmers wont ignore certain crops for no reason anymore
When a viking takes resources from a storage it now displays all of them
The dirt tiles under the workshop is now less obnoxious
The Tool progress bar for woodchoppers no longer vanishes
Fixed a bug where woodchoppers would turn braindead for long periods of time
Toolcrafters and Woodchoppers now use tools along with everyone else
Autosaves no longer overwrite all other autosaves from the same day
Autosaves no longer save roads that have not been confirmed yet, which would result in an awkward state of unfonfirmed but confirmed anyway when you load that game
Fixed a bug where the camera would get stuck if you focused on a viking
Stopping a viking that is crafting a tool now refunds the amount of resources it was using to craft that tool
The viking dragging option now toggles as it should
